ACCOMMODATE (v. t.):
I To adapt, con-
-form: Ph. a yourself to the whims of nature
विधिविलसितान्यनुवर्तस्व (?).
II To reconcile,
adjust: q. v.
III To supply with conve-
-niences: Ph.:
a. me with lodgings
*वासदानेन
 मामुपकुरु।

ACCOMMODATION:
I Adaptation: q. v.:
उपयोगिता।
II Reconciliation: q. v.
III
Conveniences: Ph.:
we received every a.
in the inn.
सर्वोपकरणान्यस्माभिः पथिकाश्रमे समधिगतानि।
IV A loan of money: Ph.
a. bill
*उपकरण-
पत्रम्।

ACCOMPANIED BY: Often expr. by any comp.
with स-:
as if a. by attendants
ससचिव इव, Ki.
x. 14. N. B. Note the fol. exx. a. by Sachi
शचीसखः, R. viii. 32;
a. by Rati
रतिद्धितीयः
Ku. iii. 35;
a. by his mistress
गृहिणीसहायः
R. ii. 24.

ACCOMPANIMENT: Ph. singing in a. with drums
मृदङ्गानुगतसङ्गीतम्, Ra. i.

ACCOMPANY:
I To go with:
(1) अनु-गच्छति,
 अन्वेति, etc.: a. d by some of the chief Kiratas
अन्वीतः स कतिपयैः किरातवर्यैः Ki. xii. 52: v. To
go after, follow;
(2) सहचरः (री, रं) भवति
(भू, c. i.) (with gen.);
(3) गच्छति, याति etc.
with सह and ins.:
I will a. you
त्वया सह गमि-
ष्यामि।
II To play in accompaniment:
(1)
अनुगच्छति (गम्, c. 1.);
(2) अनुसरति (सृ, c. 1.)
ACCOMPLICE: सहायः: v. Accessory.

ACCOMPLISHED (adj.):
I Finished, performed:
(1) सिद्धः (द्धा, द्धं);
(2) निष्पन्नः (न्ना, न्नं);
(3) निवृत्तः (त्ता, त्तं)
II Clever, refined:
(1) विशारदः (दा, दं);
(2) विचक्षणः (णा, णं);
(3) कृतिन् (f. नी):
let the a. enjoy it with
pleasure
तत् सुप्रसन्नमनसः कृतिनो भजन्ताम्, Vi. i.
N. B. The last word generally used absol.
But see Ki. xiv. 2.

ACCORD (subs.):
I Agreement, concur-
-rence: q. v.: Ph.
let us all with one a. fly
up with the net
नर्वैरेकचित्तीभूय जालमादायीङ्ङीयताम्,
H. i.,
of one's own a.
स्वेच्छातः।
II Concord,
harmony. q. v.

ACCORD (v.):
I Trans: v. To grant.
II
Intrans: v. To harmonise, agree.

ACCORDANCE WITH IN:
(1) Comp with अनुसारेण;
in a. with it
तदनुसारेण;
(2) Sometimes by the
sim. abl. or ins: in a. with the king's command
राजाञ्जया,
in a. with my saying
मद्वचनात्, Mr.:
v. According to.

ACCORDING TO:
(1) By any. comp.
with
यथा,
a. to rite
यथाविधि; punishing a. to (the nature of)
the offence (committed) यथापराधदण्डानां, R. i. 6.;
(2) When indicating order or succession
by अनुक्रमेण, क्रमेण, or by any comp. with अनु-,
not a. to (the seniority of)
the mother
न मातृक्रमेण;
K. b.;
a. to regular order
अनुपूर्वशः, M. : v.
In accordance with.

ACCORDINGLY (adv.): तथैव: v. Agreeably,
conformably.

ACCORDINGLY (conj.): Often understood or
expr. by: circumlocution: Ph. ‘the princess
is come, come to see her’, (saying this) she went
and we
a. followed her
प्राप्तैवेयं भर्तृदारिका, आगच्छतां
 द्रष्ट मित्ययासीत् । तामन्वयाव चावां, D. vi.;
he a.
followed me
तथोक्तः मामनुवव्राज: v. Consequ-
-ently, therefore.

ACCOST (v. t.): आ-मन्त्रयति (मन्त्र्, c. 10): v.
To address.

ACCOUCHEMENT:
(1) गर्भनिर्गमः;
(2) प्रसवः:
v. Delivery.

ACCOUCHEUR:
(1) कुमारभृत्याकुशलो भिषक्, R. iii.
12.;
(2) प्रजननकुशलः (पुरुषः), Sr.

ACCOUNT (subs):
I Of money: गणना;
a.
book
गणनापत्रिका, Raj.;
Balancing an a.
गण-
नामेकीकृत्य, Raj.;
render an a. for me
मदर्थं गणनां
 कुरु।
II Estimation: q. v. गणना।
III Im-
-portance, value, advantage: q. v.
IV A
narrative or description: q. v.
(1) विवरणम्;
(2) विवृत्तिः: v. Reason, consideration:
q. v.: Ph.
on this a.
अतः,
on what a.
किमर्थम्
or
किन्निमित्तम्।
or no a.
न कथञ्चन; on all a. s
सर्वथा।

ACCOUNT (v. t.): गणयति (गण्, c. 10.): v.
To consider, esteem.

ACCOUNT OF, ON:
(1) By the abl.:
on a. of
having no power
अप्रभुत्वात्, D. ;
(2) Sometimes
by the ins especially if the word ends in ता,
on a. of my childhood
बालतया,;
(3) By -निमित्तः
(त्ता, त्तं),
as we are reduced to this state on a.
of the enemy
द्विषन्निमित्ता यदियं दशा, Ki. i. 41.:
v. For the sake of.

ACCOUNT FOR,:
I To assign the cause of:
कारणं दर्शयति, प्र-, (c. of दृश्) (with gen.):
v. To explain.
II To render an account:
Ph.
a. for the money received
*यद्धनं प्राप्तं तस्य
 गणनां देहि।

ACCOUNTABLE: Ph.
I. apprehend you are a. for
his death
*त्वद्दोषात्तस्य मरणमाशङ्के;
every one is a.
to God for his conduct
*सर्वैरीश्वरायात्मकार्याणां
 न्यायान्यायौ प्रदर्शयितव्यौ।

ACCOUNTANT: perh. गणकः; chief a., a.-general
गणनाध्यक्षः, RAJ.

ACCOUTRE (v. t.): सं-नह्यति (नह्, c. 4.): v.
To equip, arm.
ACONITE: A poison: वत्सनाभः।
ACORN: i. e. The fruit of the oak: v. Oak.

ACOUSTIC:
(1) श्रौतः (ती, तं);
(2) Comp. with
श्रोत्र-।
ACOUSTICS: *शब्दविद्या।
